abstract: Based on a sample of elderly individuals from the Survey of Health, Ageing, and Retirement in Europe, we investigate the relationship between job and marital stability over the life cycle. We argue that an unobserved, time-varying social skill affects stability in both markets. Using a grouped fixed-effects estimator, we show that unobserved relationship stability in both markets is significantly and positively associated. Instability in both markets is associated with lower levels of trust and conscientiousness, and higher levels of extraversion and neuroticism. The absence of the father during childhood perpetuates higher instability later in life. Higher instability is also costly as it is associated with lower levels of late-life well-being.
abstract_zh: 基于欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查中老年个体的样本，我们考察了生命周期中职业与婚姻稳定性的关系。我们认为，一种未被观测到的、随时间变化的社会技能影响着两个市场的稳定性。采用分组固定效应估计方法，我们发现在两个市场中，未被观测到的关系稳定性之间存在显著的正向关联。两个市场中的不稳定性与较低的信任度和尽责性，以及较高的外向性和神经质水平相关。童年时期父亲的缺失会加剧晚年生活中的更高不稳定性。更高的不稳定性代价高昂，因为它与晚年福祉水平较低相关联。
title: Relationship stability: evidence from labor and marriage markets
title_zh: 关系稳定性：来自劳动力市场与婚姻市场的证据

abstract: We examine whether access to the Federal Reserve's Overnight Reverse Repo Facility (ON RRP) affects money market fund flows during flight-to-safety episodes. We find that funds with ON RRP access serving sophisticated investors experience about a 1 percentage point increase in net daily flows over total assets during the March 2020 flight-to-safety episode relative to similar funds without access. The effect aligns with theoretical predictions and explains more than half of the inflows in those funds. Our results show that access to central bank deposit facilities amplifies flight-to-safety behavior.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了在避险时期，美联储隔夜逆回购工具（ON RRP）的准入是否影响货币市场基金的资金流动。我们发现，在2020年3月的避险事件中，相较于没有准入资格的类似基金，拥有ON RRP准入且服务于成熟投资者的基金，其每日净流入占总资产的比例约增加1个百分点。这一效应与理论预测相符，并解释了这些基金中超过一半的资金流入。我们的结果表明，中央银行存款工具的准入加剧了避险行为。
title: Central bank access and flight to safety
